annotation.msg: INITIALIZE-SINGLE-SOURCE: setting d[v] = ∞ and π[v] = NIL for every vertex v
d[${source.id}] ← 0  (source has zero distance to itself)

annotation.question: Is d[${v.id}] = ${getDist(v) === Infinity ? '∞' : getDist(v)} > d[${u.id}] + w(${u.id},${v.id}) = ${getDist(u) === Infinity ? '∞' : getDist(u) + w}?
annotation.answer: ${getDist(v) > getDist(u) + w ? 'Yes — relax the edge and update d[' + v.id + ']' : 'No — current path is already optimal'}

annotation.msg: DIJKSTRA: beginning shortest-path computation from source ${source.id}
Call INITIALIZE-SINGLE-SOURCE to set up distance estimates
S ← ∅  (set of settled vertices whose shortest paths are known)
Q ← V  (min-priority queue containing all vertices, keyed by d[v])
EXTRACT-MIN: remove vertex u = ${u.id} with d[u] = ${getDist(u) === Infinity ? '∞' : getDist(u)} from Q
S ← S ∪ {${u.id}}  (${u.id}'s shortest path is now finalised)
Mark ${u.id} as settled — d[${u.id}] = ${getDist(u) === Infinity ? '∞' : getDist(u)} is optimal
Checking edges out of ${u.id} — relaxing each neighbour
Neighbour v = ${v.id},  current d[${v.id}] = ${getDist(v) === Infinity ? '∞' : getDist(v)}
DIJKSTRA complete — all shortest paths from ${source.id} have been computed
